proof_scope: In progress. R1765 formalizes the real fractional-linear action of actual SL(2,R) matrices. It proves inverse/product identities away from the pole, finite exceptional sets, measurability, positive Jacobian off the pole, and global change of variables and integrability equivalence. The weighted pullback W_g(f)(x)=|c*x+d|^(-1)*f((a*x+b)/(c*x+d)) preserves squared integrals and respects almost-everywhere equality. It descends to a linear isometric equivalence of the actual L2 quotient. T_g=W_(g inverse) is packaged as a group homomorphism into linear isometric equivalences, with norm, inverse, composition and inner-product laws proved. Determinant-one rational maps and their square-root-Jacobian action agree exactly with this global construction. Their finite symmetric average is a continuous linear contraction and is symmetric for the real inner product. The actual L2 restricted-gap premise implies the function-form premise from R1764, and hence the proved continuous expansion bound. Neither gap existence nor strong continuity in the matrix parameter is asserted.
next: Advance the quantitative restricted-gap proof using the now proved symmetric contraction. First formalize cancellation from the exact zero cell means: pairing a unit-supported function with a Lipschitz test function is bounded by its cell oscillation times the L1 norm. Derive an explicit low-frequency Fourier bound (using complex-valued tests or separate sine/cosine tests) and the resulting small low-frequency L2 projection, keeping the Fourier convention and all constants explicit. Then transfer a correlation at least 1/2 to the high-frequency component with a positive margin, as in source Claim 3.2. Inspect and reuse Mathlib Fourier/Plancherel APIs before introducing new infrastructure. Continue with the needed frequency localization, matrix-parameter regularity and finite-word/convolution estimates toward Theorem 1.3; flattening Theorem 3.1, product growth, Proposition 3.5 and rational-generator existence remain real proof obligations, not assumptions that complete paid padding. Recheck the source inequalities rather than copying typography or informal asymptotic claims. Preserve affine motion 200/210, recursion 206/208 and final referee review as outstanding parts of the same full goal.
